metadata.name: Geochemical Analysis of Mafic Rock Samples from Arctic Seafloor (PS101 Cruise)
metadata.description: This dataset contains replicate geochemical analyses (weight percent of major oxides) of a mafic rock sample collected from the deep Arctic seafloor at the Gakkel Ridge region. The sample was collected during the PS101 expedition on October 4, 2016, at a depth of 3,254 meters. The dataset includes 11 oxide composition columns (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5) plus a Total column for quality control, along with sample identification, geospatial coordinates, and sampling timestamp.
metadata.spatial: Point location with ~10-100 meter precision (5 decimal places in decimal degrees)
